headline: Akamai: A Competitive Dilemma Repeating Itself
summary: Akamai stock looks unattractive: weak return on capital, low forward earnings yield, and better-valued rivals (MSFT, META, GOOGL).

headline: Hush Security Raises $30M to Close the AI Agent Governance Gap, with Akamai Joining as Strategic Investor
summary: Hush Security, a pioneer in securing the non-human workforce, today announced a $30 million Series A funding round, with Akamai Technologies joining as a strategic investor alongside existing investors Battery Ventures and YL Ventures. Less than a year out of stealth, the round brings Hush's total capital raised to $41 million.
